scenarios.title: Melee gives +1/+1 when the creature attacks
decisions: A moves to combat and declares Wings of the Guard as the only attacker, attacking player B.
Both players pass priority; the melee trigger resolves, then combat damage is dealt.

variants.label: melee_creature_attacks
variants.expected: The melee trigger of Wings of the Guard fires and resolves: it is 2/2 until end of turn. B is unblocked, takes 2 combat damage and is at 18.

variants.label: melee_creature_stays_home
variants.delta: A attacks with Mons's Goblin Raiders only; Wings of the Guard does not attack.
variants.expected: The melee trigger does not fire. Wings of the Guard stays 1/1. B takes 1 combat damage and is at 19.

scenarios.title: Each instance of melee triggers separately
decisions: A moves to the beginning of combat; the Fang of the Pack trigger targets Wings of the Guard.
The trigger resolves and Wings of the Guard gains melee until end of turn, on top of its own melee.
A declares Wings of the Guard as the only attacker, attacking player B. Fang of the Pack and Mons's Goblin Raiders stay home.
Both players pass priority; both melee triggers resolve, then combat damage is dealt.

variants.label: two_instances
variants.expected: Two separate melee triggers of Wings of the Guard fire and resolve: it is 3/3 until end of turn. B is unblocked, takes 3 combat damage and is at 17.

variants.label: one_instance
variants.delta: The Fang of the Pack trigger targets Mons's Goblin Raiders instead of Wings of the Guard.
variants.expected: Wings of the Guard has one instance of melee, so one melee trigger fires and it is 2/2 until end of turn. B takes 2 combat damage and is at 18.

scenarios.forge_notes: Fang of the Pack grants melee as a keyword through a pump effect; Forge must keep the granted instance distinct from the printed one.
